definition: The entries filed directly inside this one, and, for a tradition or family, every style and variant filed beneath it. Filing is for finding things and passes nothing down; where a style really comes from is in Lineage.
analogy: Like the drawer a card is kept in: it tells you where to look, not whose child it is.
basis: Editorial. README.md: filing "is the drawer a node lives in. It exists for browsing and nothing else." docs/model.md gives the variant as "The regional or period expression at which a kit is actually buildable", and filing "is a strict single-parent tree. Traditions have" no parent, and "It does not carry inheritance."

surface.what: The entries filed inside this one.
read: Filing puts each entry in exactly one drawer, for finding it; it carries no inheritance.
For a tradition or a family, every style and variant filed beneath it is listed too.
Where a style really comes from is in its Lineage section.
